name: Mha PLC Ord 1p
summary: Mha Plc delivers a wide array of financial and strategic advisory services tailored for both businesses and individual clients. Their comprehensive service portfolio encompasses auditing, accounting, tax compliance, VAT consultation, corporate finance, corporate recovery and counter-fraud measures, business strategy development, outsourcing solutions, and cloud accounting. Established in 1869, the firm operates from its headquarters in Milton Keynes, United Kingdom. It is slated to officially adopt the name Mha Plc in March 2025, having formerly been recognized as Project Balance Topco 1 PLC.
